[CRITICAL] CLOSE_REQUIRED
subject: plan-0001
reason: NO_POSITION_ON_STOP_BUT_EXPOSED
at: 2026-10-09T03:00:00Z
What happened: The exchange refused the stop because it saw no position, but the position read that followed shows an open position (NO_POSITION_ON_STOP_BUT_EXPOSED).
Position: A position is open without a stop.
System already did: The plan moved to CLOSE_REQUIRED, new entries are blocked (SAFE_MODE CLOSE_REQUIRED) and a reduce-only MARKET emergency close was attempted; if that close fails, EMERGENCY_CLOSE_FAILED or EMERGENCY_CLOSE_NOT_SENT follows as its own alert.
You must: Check the exchange position and the journal before any manual action. If the position is still open, close it or protect it yourself.
